items.name: VTT-Transcription-App
items.description: This open-source, R-based web application allows the conversion of video captions (subtitles) from the Web Video Text Tracks (WebVTT) Format into plain texts. For this purpose, users upload a WebVTT file with the extension of 'vtt' or 'txt'. Automatically, metadata such as timestamps are removed, and the text is formatted.
